blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Nxled coach Ettore Guidetti is relishing the luxury of having a deep, talent-rich roster in the PVL All-Filipino Conference Siklab Series, where the all-to-play format has played to his team’s advantage. With three-time MVP Brooke Van Sickle returning from her shoulder injury, Nxled flexed its depth by sweeping Invitational bronze medalist PLDT, 25-16, 25-20, 25-18, to jumpstart its new season on Tuesday at Smart Araneta Coliseum.
